{{Top|leg}}
A '''sun skimmer''' was a term for a used to describe an object that was located close to a [[Star/Legends|star]]. One of the two [[Bespin-class gas giant|''Bespin''-class gas giants]] in the [[Horuz system/Legends|Horuz system]] was a sun skimmer.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
